title: logDose gates next-dose scheduling behind a notifyOnNextDose parameter
name: logDose
description: Adds a notifyOnNextDose: Boolean parameter (the caller's per-dose toggle choice). The existing ExactAlarmScheduler.schedule call -- previously unconditional whenever nextEligible/medication were non-null -- now also requires notifyOnNextDose to be true. All other logic (timing evaluation, DoseLog insert, outcome callback) is unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: Signature gains notifyOnNextDose: Boolean as a new parameter, placed after acknowledgeWarning and before onResult
The DoseLog insert always happens regardless of notifyOnNextDose (it only gates the reminder, not the log itself)
ExactAlarmScheduler.schedule(...) is now called only when notifyOnNextDose && nextEligible != null && medication != null
Everything else in the function body is byte-for-byte unchanged
exact_code:
fun logDose(
        profileId: Int,
        medicationId: Int,
        givenAtEpochMillis: Long,
        doseAmount: String,
        acknowledgeWarning: Boolean,
        notifyOnNextDose: Boolean,
        onResult: (LogDoseOutcome) -> Unit,
    ) {
        viewModelScope.launch {
            val medication = medicationRepository.getById(medicationId)
            val mostRecentDose = doseLogRepository.getMostRecentDoseSnapshot(profileId, medicationId)
            val timing = DoseTimingCalculator.evaluateTiming(
                givenAtEpochMillis,
                mostRecentDose,
                medication?.minIntervalMinutes,
            )
            if (timing is DoseTimingResult.TooSoon && !acknowledgeWarning) {
                onResult(LogDoseOutcome.NeedsConfirmation(timing.minutesRemaining))
                return@launch
            }
            val nextEligible = DoseTimingCalculator.computeNextEligible(
                givenAtEpochMillis,
                medication?.minIntervalMinutes,
            )
            val doseLogId = doseLogRepository.insert(
                DoseLog(
                    profileId = profileId,
                    medicationId = medicationId,
                    givenAtEpochMillis = givenAtEpochMillis,
                    doseAmount = doseAmount,
                    nextEligibleAtEpochMillis = nextEligible,
                    wasOverrideWarningAcknowledged = timing is DoseTimingResult.TooSoon,
                ),
            )
            if (notifyOnNextDose && nextEligible != null && medication != null) {
                val (title, text) = ReminderMessage.build(getApplication(), medication.name, nextEligible)
                ExactAlarmScheduler.schedule(
                    getApplication<Application>(),
                    doseLogId.toInt(),
                    nextEligible,
                    title,
                    text,
                )
            }
            onResult(LogDoseOutcome.Logged)
        }
    }
